bio.text: Barbara Kahl is the Republican candidate for Oregon's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary.

Ballotpedia reports she graduated from Hillsboro High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Oregon State University in 2001 and graduated from the OSU College of Veterinary Medicine in 2006, and works as a veterinarian.

In her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey response, she says she is a fourth-generation Oregonian who ran a mobile veterinary practice for nearly 20 years and lives with her husband on farmland in rural Oregon.
